label: Mk1 survey mast
note: Doc 20 section 4.1's mast: a scan takes ten minutes and 1,000 cu and reads the ground 48 cells out from a 250 cm mast, the nine fields around the rig's own from its middle; a sounding takes twenty minutes and 2,000 cu and reads 16 cells out, a whole field, and the quiet sounding 8, a quarter. Every radius is per axis, a square of 2r + 1 cells a side, the site grid's own metric.
